'''Ibaar''' was a [[mountain]]ous,<ref name="Wings of the Master" /> rocky, and [[Temperature|temperate]] [[planet]]<ref name="VE" /> located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Rebel Jail, Part II" /> that fell under [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] control in the [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]]. The Empire created a [[Blockade of Ibaar|blockade]] around the planet that cut off vital supplies from the Ibaarian people. An [[Ibaar rebel network|underground network]] of Ibaarians was assisted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]] which delivered the needed supplies to Ibaar.<ref name="Wings of the Master" /> Despite this, Ibaar continued to suffer under Imperial sanctions well into the [[Galactic Civil War]] due to its suspected Rebel sympathies.<ref name="Rebel Jail, Part II" />

According to [[First Order]] [[propaganda]] holos, Ibaar had undergone famine in the [[time]] following the Galactic Civil War while it was under [[New Republic]] control.<ref name="BTA" />
